source.role: behavior reference only; never executed, never shipped

statuses.carried: The JavaScript test asserts the same behavior directly; only the language and the harness differ.
statuses.adapted: The behavior is kept but its mechanism changed (Copier, Make, uv or Python replaced by the renderer, the pnpm run facade, hooks, pnpm or Node core), and the JavaScript tests prove the adapted form.
statuses.not-carried: The behavior is specific to Python tooling (uv, venv, taplo, mdformat, Make recipes, MkDocs) or to a feature the JavaScript template does not have, so no JavaScript test proves it.
